text: Top-K relevance is uniform across catalog slices; any slice differences are small/noise.
rationale: Model is single rank-lgb applied to all catalog; without slice-specific bias it could rank relevant items equally well per slice.

text: Ranking quality is degraded for new-catalog slice due to weaker model scores on relevant new items.
rationale: Sample rows show 'new' slice; new items often lack behavioral features, plausible ranking degrades there.

text: Apparent slice gaps reflect data/evaluation artifacts (different relevance prevalence or query coverage) rather than model ranking failure.
rationale: Pooled precision and P@K are sensitive to label prevalence and query/slice sizes; apparent gap may reflect evaluation/data hygiene not ranking ability.
